skill.summary: Run GA4 reports, inspect properties, list audiences and data streams, and analyze traffic and conversion data — powered by ClawLink.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release integrating Google Analytics with OpenClaw via ClawLink.

- Run GA4 reports, inspect properties, list audiences and data streams, and analyze traffic and conversion data directly from chat.
- Includes detailed setup and pairing instructions for ClawLink and Google Analytics connections.
- Tools and capabilities are provided dynamically based on user integration status.
- Ensures user credentials are handled securely through ClawLink; no raw credentials required in chat.
- Outlines best practices and rules for safe use and discovery of Google Analytics tools.
